newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria cenbank allots 4.15 bln ATS in quick repo.
newsitem.headline: Austria cenbank allots 4.15 bln ATS in quick repo.

text.p: The Austrian central bank said it had allotted 4.15 billion schillings in one-day repurchase agreements aimed at bolstering the banking system's liquidity at the start of the pre-christmas shopping season.
The National Bank said it had filled 11 percent of bids.
The quick repo tender is in addition to the central bank's regular seven-day repo offer due later on Thursday. -- Vienna newsroom +431 53112 274
